# Compliance Check

> GDPR and German national law AI compliance software. Turns the EU AI Act,
> GDPR and 35 more EU and German national and sector laws (37 total, 16 of
> them German national law) into a plain-language checklist: classify each AI
> system by risk, work through the matching requirements, document evidence,
> get reminded before a review is due. Built by RIT Services, hosted entirely
> in the EU.

Not legal advice. For binding interpretation of the law, consult a qualified
lawyer.

## Pages

- [Home](https://compliance.rit.services/): Overview, the four AI Act risk
  outcomes explained, the full 37-law directory, and FAQ covering GDPR and
  German national law coverage specifically.
- [About](https://compliance.rit.services/about): Who built it (RIT Services)
  and why.
- [News](https://compliance.rit.services/news): What is changing in AI law in
  Germany and the EU (new laws, moved EU AI Act deadlines, bills in progress),
  each entry with its sources.
- [Security and GDPR](https://compliance.rit.services/security): Encryption,
  hosting, backups, retention periods, sub-processors, and what is not yet in
  place (no SOC 2 or ISO 27001 certification, stated plainly).

## Notes

- Registration is open; there is no published pricing.
- The platform is bilingual, German and English.
